How much does a move cost in Greater Paris?

Our starting prices, what changes the amount, and how to compare quotes without surprises.

5 min read · Updated 14 October 2026

Moving options

Our starting prices

  • Selffrom €600
  • Self plusfrom €800
  • Confortfrom €1,100
  • Confort plusfrom €1,600
  • Grand Confortfrom €2,500

Starting prices for a 10 m² studio in Greater Paris, with 2 movers. The price depends on volume, distance and access; it is confirmed and fixed after the survey, which is free and with no obligation.

Compare the five packages

What changes the price

  • Volume, in cubic metres: the main factor.
  • Distance between the two addresses.
  • Access: floor without lift, carrying distance, narrow street, need for a furniture lift.
  • Package: the more the team packs and dismantles for you, the more time it spends.
  • Special items: piano, artwork, bulky furniture.
  • Storage, if your dates do not match.

Planning a move?

Estimating your volume

A common rule of thumb: the volume in cubic metres is about half the floor area in square metres, a little more if the home is well furnished. For a reliable estimate, use our room-by-room calculator.

Comparing quotes properly

  • Check that each quote covers the same volume and the same services.
  • Prefer a quote made after a survey: it reflects the real access.
  • Ask how your belongings are insured and what the declaration of value covers.
  • Insist on a written, detailed quote.

The full method: how to compare quotes.

Keeping the cost down

  • Declutter before the quote: less volume, less time.
  • Pack yourself, with the Self and Self plus packages.
  • Stay flexible on the date if you can.

Cody’s tip

A quote without a survey is only an estimate. At CODEM, the survey is free and the price is fixed afterwards.

Frequently asked questions

Can the price change on moving day?

The price is confirmed and fixed after the survey. Tell us before moving day about any change in volume or access, so the quote stays accurate.

Is there any financial help?

Depending on your situation: the Caf moving allowance for families with at least three children, subject to conditions, or employer support for a job transfer.
